nodes.name: Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives: business_name, city, service_radius_km, industry, owner_whatsapp

nodes.name: Geocode City Centre
nodes.notes: Gets lat/lng of city centre for radius calculations

nodes.name: Get All Suburbs In Radius
nodes.notes: Returns all suburb/locality names within the radius. Falls back to postcode lookup if empty.

values.content:
=You are a local SEO strategist specialising in Australian markets.

Business: {{ $('Intake Webhook').item.json.business_name }}
Industry: {{ $('Intake Webhook').item.json.industry }}
City: {{ $('Intake Webhook').item.json.city }}
Service Radius: {{ $('Intake Webhook').item.json.service_radius_km }}km

Suburbs found within radius:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.results.map(r => r.name), null, 2) }}

Assign each suburb a priority tier:
- Tier 1: High commercial density, high population, high search volume for this industry — top 20 max
- Tier 2: Residential areas with medium volume — next 40
- Tier 3: Outer fringe, low volume but still worth targeting — remainder

Also for each Tier 1 suburb, list:
- Estimated monthly search volume for '[industry] + [suburb]' (rough)
- Key local landmarks or identifiers (for landing page copy)
- Any industry-specific notes (e.g. 'heritage homes = more plumbing work')

Return as JSON:
{
  "tier1": [{"name": "...", "lat": ..., "lng": ..., "monthly_searches": ..., "landmarks": "...", "notes": "..."}],
  "tier2": [{"name": "...", "lat": ..., "lng": ..."}],
  "tier3": [{"name": "...", "lat": ..., "lng": ..."}],
  "total_suburbs": ...,
  "recommended_gbp_profiles": ...
}

nodes.name: Claude — Tier Assignment
nodes.notes: Claude assigns each suburb to Tier 1/2/3 based on commercial density and industry relevance

nodes.name: Save Tier Map to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Saves the full suburb tier map for use by GBP builder, landing page generator, and grid scanner

parameters.message:
=✅ *City mapped for {{ $('Intake Webhook').item.json.business_name }}*

🗺️ *{{ $json.total_suburbs }} suburbs* found within {{ $('Intake Webhook').item.json.service_radius_km }}km radius.

🟢 *Tier 1 (priority targets):* {{ $json.tier1.length }} suburbs
{{ $json.tier1.slice(0,8).map(s => '• ' + s.name).join('\n') }}{{ $json.tier1.length > 8 ? '\n+ ' + ($json.tier1.length - 8) + ' more...' : '' }}

🟡 *Tier 2:* {{ $json.tier2.length }} suburbs
🔵 *Tier 3:* {{ $json.tier3.length }} suburbs

📋 *Recommended GBP profiles to build:* {{ $json.recommended_gbp_profiles }}

⚙️ Next: GBP Network Builder is starting now...

nodes.name: WhatsApp — City Map Complete
nodes.notes: Notifies owner with suburb tier breakdown. Uses Twilio WhatsApp API.

main.node: Save Tier Map to Google Sheets

meta.description: Maps the entire city into tiered suburb targets. Geocodes every suburb within radius, assigns Tier 1/2/3 priority using Claude, saves to Sheets, notifies owner via WhatsApp, and triggers the GBP Network Builder.
